usage: agentware graph show [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                            [--render {text,dot,mermaid}]
                            name

positional arguments:
  name                  graph name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --render {text,dot,mermaid}
                        text renderer (default: text)
